name: Vista Global Holding Limited
note: Dubai (DIFC)-headquartered private aviation group; 'Vista' is its trade name and VistaJet and XO are its brands (its own materials). A USD 600m minority investment led by RRJ Capital (with Andalusian Private Capital) was agreed in March 2025; founder and chairman Thomas Flohr remains the majority owner (ch-aviation, 2025-03-19). S&P also describes Rhône Capital as a minority ordinary shareholder.
